guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: extremely well documented — SRV's well-worn 1963/1962-hybrid Strat nicknamed "Number One" is among the most famous guitars in blues-rock.

tone.target: Texas blues Strat crunch with springy low end and biting upper mids
tone.profile: Texas blues Strat crunch with springy low end and biting upper mids
tone.summary: A classic Texas blues setup using a Boost pedal for grit, followed by a US Deluxe amp model, paired with a 2x12 cabinet to capture the bright, articulate sound of a Stratocaster.

rig.name: Stevie Ray Vaughan & Double Trouble - Pride And Joy - Valeton GP-180
